title: レバー式ペーパーカッター
description: 役所・図書館の作業台やコピー室に置くレバー式裁断器の静的外観。脚付きテーブル、数字のない位置合わせ線、後端フェンス、固定位置の可動ストッパーとロックつまみ、上げた刃・握り・軸、隙間を持つ固定ガードと下面補強を造形。目盛りの精度や実際の裁断・ガード動作はなく、刃は表示用の厚みを持つ形状です。安全性・切断性能や認証は示しません。 ゲーム・可視化向け。製造・構造設計・3Dプリント用途は未検証。 外接寸法（X×Y×Z）0.559 × 0.522 × 0.739 m、6,616三角形。単位m・Y-up、水平中央の接地用原点、最下点Y=0。部品ごとの重複UV0と単色PBR材質を収録し、画像テクスチャ・UV2・コライダー・LOD・リグ・動作は付属しません。静的表示用でUnity/VRChat実機検証は未実施。STLはm・Y-up座標の形状のみで色・材質・UV・階層を含みません。
descriptionEn: A static lever paper-cutter prop for public-office, library and copy-room worktops. Includes a footed table, unnumbered alignment lines, rear fence, fixed-position adjustable stop/lock knob, raised blade/handle/pivot, open fixed guard and underside stiffeners. Alignment marks are not calibrated; cutting and guard operation are absent, and the blade has deliberately finite visual thickness. No safety, cutting-performance or certification claims. For games and visualization; not validated for manufacture, structural engineering or 3D printing. Bounding dimensions (X×Y×Z): 0.559 × 0.522 × 0.739 m; 6,616 triangles. Metres, Y-up, horizontally centered placement origin with minimum Y=0, not an articulation or wall-mount pivot. Includes overlapping component UV0 and constant-color PBR materials, with no image textures, unique UV2, colliders, LOD, rig or runtime behavior. Static visualization only; Unity/VRChat editor and runtime tests have not been performed. STL uses metre-valued Y-up coordinates and contains geometry only, without color, materials, UVs or hierarchy.
author: Xenoah
uv: Per-component primitive or automatically unwrapped UVs. Overlapping between components; not a packed unique lightmap atlas. Solid-color PBR materials; no external textures. STL has no colors or UVs.
